safety.boundary: unchanged; represented by the existing fall_out rule and terminates immediately

stopping_rule: Stop immediately at success, collision, fall/boundary, or timeout. Safety takes precedence over success; success takes precedence over timeout.
dataset_policy: The immutable dataset is not regenerated. Its stored terminal labels and settle_count use the original 5-step/0.10-m/s collection criterion and retain that provenance.
scope: All active experiment evaluations and predictive control; immutable historical collection labels retain their collection provenance.
